name: Inspect scientific Python packages
summary: List installed versions of the scientific workshop packages or named distributions.
description: Inspect installed distribution metadata without importing executable modules. Default names: numpy, scipy, sympy, mpmath, pandas, matplotlib, pillow. Optional names (at most 32) checks other distribution names; a null version means not installed. Does not install/download or grant any permission. Use python.run with help() for offline library docstrings; projects, computations, plots and raster images can be created and revised in your workspace.

demonstrations.title: Unavailable distributions are reported explicitly, never installed.

limitations: Characters are Unicode code points, not grapheme clusters, so some emoji count as more than one.
Input longer than 1,000,000 characters is rejected.

failure_modes.condition: The 'text' argument is missing or is not a string.
failure_modes.symptom: The call is rejected before execution with an input validation error.
failure_modes.recovery: Pass the text as a JSON string under the key 'text'.
